messages.content: 将用户任务整理为结构化 Prompt Brief。只输出严格 JSON，字段契约与合法示例如下：{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["taskName","taskType","role","goal","context","input","tasks","constraints","output"],"maxTotalCharacters":30000,"properties":{"taskName":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":10000,"pattern":"\\S"},"taskType":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":10000,"pattern":"\\S"},"role":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":10000,"pattern":"\\S"},"goal":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":10000,"pattern":"\\S"},"context":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":10000,"pattern":"\\S"},"input":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":10000,"pattern":"\\S"},"tasks":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":10000,"pattern":"\\S"},"constraints":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":10000,"pattern":"\\S"},"output":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":10000,"pattern":"\\S"}},"unknownInformation":"明确写待用户补充；禁止推测或虚构。","example":{"taskName":"经销商访谈准备","taskType":"客户访谈","role":"快消产品经理","goal":"梳理订货与补货流程","context":"企业、区域和现有流程未知，待用户补充","input":"待用户提供访谈背景和已有资料","tasks":"1. 列出访谈问题\n2. 标记需要确认的信息","constraints":"区分事实、整理和推断；不得编造","output":"按主题分组的问题清单"}}。未知业务信息写“待用户补充”，不得虚构。

{"task":"为虚构快消企业的产品经理设计一次30分钟需求访谈，了解经销商订货流程；结合所选Wiki仅说明结构化输出概念，不推断ROI或成本收益。输出访谈目标、问题、记录表和待确认事项。","template":"customer_interview","templates":[{"id":"industry_learning","label":"行业学习"},{"id":"business_process","label":"业务流程分析"},{"id":"customer_interview","label":"客户访谈"},{"id":"requirements","label":"需求分析"},{"id":"ai_solution","label":"AI方案设计"},{"id":"meeting_notes","label":"会议资料整理"},{"id":"custom","label":"自定义任务"}]}
